name: web-application-security-course
description: Markdown-first Web Application Security course materials with Reveal.js slides.

scripts.slides:html: mkdir -p build/html && for deck in lectures/week*/slides.md; do week=$(basename $(dirname "$deck")); reveal-md "$deck" --static "build/html/$week"; done
scripts.slides:pptx: mkdir -p build/pptx && for deck in lectures/week*/slides.md; do week=$(basename $(dirname "$deck")); pandoc "$deck" --from markdown --to pptx --output "build/pptx/$week.pptx"; done
scripts.materials:generate: ruby tools/generate_course_materials.rb && ruby tools/refine_assessments.rb && ruby tools/create_editions_and_refinements.rb
